key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran Tensions and Surging Oil Prices Trigger Risk-Off Sentiment
reasoning: Ongoing US strikes on Iran and an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz pushed oil to $94, a novel geopolitical shock. The Nasdaq-100 pre-market decline of -0.52% indicates the market has not absorbed this risk, especially with unresolved tensions likely to escalate further.
